children: PancakeSwap's Pre-Access Portal goes live, offering tokenized, fully onchain, self-custodial exposure to private companies before they go public. The portal is accessible through Binance Wallet. Each position is held directly by the investor, and the products cover companies that have not yet completed a public listing. PancakeSwap positions the release as a new vertical on the exchange, with a first project reveal expected to follow.

The launch gives CAKE a fee-generating vertical beyond spot trading and perps, since private-market placements typically carry distinct fee structures. Traders may reprice the token on this access to pre-IPO exposure, a market segment previously hard to reach onchain. The specific companies and deal terms remain undisclosed until the first project reveal, so the portal's actual demand and revenue contribution cannot be verified yet. Until then, the release is a structural change to PancakeSwap's product set rather than a confirmed earnings driver.
→ Tokenized, indirect exposure to private companies before they go public

title: PancakeSwap: Pre-Access Portal Goes Live With Tokenized Pre-IPO Exposure - 20 Sep 2026
